0022600190.text: The Nets (2-6, 1-3 on the road, 13th in the East) visit the Atlanta Hawks (6-4, first in the Southeast, 4th in the East, on a three-game winning streak) for Brooklyn's ninth game of the season, with Brooklyn coming in on a one-game win streak and five games back in the Atlantic. Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe) and Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Nets lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 season series, most recently falling 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
